facts.statement: Ukraine and Russia signed an agreement on the joint use and protection of border water bodies in Kyiv on 19 October 1992.
facts.source: Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine, legislation database: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 1488 of 30 December 2022
facts.note: Day not confirmed; Ukraine's Cabinet reportedly ended water cooperation with Russia on 30 December (probably 2022), check the decree. Found (search excerpts of zakon.rada.gov.ua, page not opened): Resolution No. 1488 of 30 December 2022 ends the agreement “done on 19 October 1992 in Kyiv”.

facts.statement: The Kakhovka dam on the Dnipro was destroyed on 6 June 2023, flooding areas downstream.
facts.source: UN OCHA, Ukraine: Destruction of the Kakhovka dam, Flash update

facts.statement: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers ended the 1992 agreement with Russia on the joint use and protection of border water bodies on 30 December 2022.
facts.source: Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine, legislation database: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 1488 of 30 December 2022
facts.note: Found through search excerpts of the resolution page (zakon.rada.gov.ua refused the connection). LexInform reports it in force from 4 January 2023. For Justinas to review.
